textRuns.value: Native MOVINGAVERAGE is appliesTo: [visual-calculation] -- it can only be used inside a report visual calculation, never in a measure or in a DAX query. WINDOW is appliesTo: [measure, column, table, visual-calculation] -- it works in all four. That is why the moving average in this library is built with WINDOW + AVERAGEX: it is the only way for it to work as a reusable measure.
